factories.name: newListDocumentsStep
factories.description: List one page of document resource names in a collection of the default Firestore database.

inputSchema.description: ListDocumentsInput selects one bounded collection page in the default Firestore database.

collectionId.description: CollectionID is the top-level collection ID shown in Firestore Documents.

pageSize.description: PageSize limits this page to 1 through 100 documents; zero uses 100.

pageToken.description: PageToken is returned by the previous page; blank selects the first page.

projectId.description: ProjectID is the Google Cloud project ID shown in Firestore Databases.
